caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition bordered by thick black lines with alternating segments of red, light green, and white along the edges. Inside the rectangle, there is a large black cross that extends almost to the top and bottom borders. On the left side of the cross is a human arm and a leg, both pale with red lines indicating wounds, with the hand and foot extending rightward; the limb is draped with a red cloth or sash. On the right side, another pale-blue sleeve covers the second arm, which is outstretched, and the hand appears to be nailed to the cross, with a wound at the wrist. Beneath the arm on the right is a round object that appears to be a wreath, green with red berry-like dots, near the bottom right. On the bottom left inside the rectangle, there are three black nails. The background of the inner rectangle is a light pink color, and the top of the drawing has a green band. Above the inner composition, for the upper border and sides, there are decorative elements in red, white, and black, which appear as scalloped drapes or designs. The overall palette consists of black, red, light green, pale pink, pale blue, and white.
title: Detail from Main Reredos at Sanctuario Church, Chimayo
